name: Mercedes-Benz CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Mercedes-Benz Group AG manufactures and distributes premium cars. It reports through Mercedes-Benz Cars, Mercedes-Benz Vans and Mercedes-Benz Mobility segments, with brands such as Mercedes-AMG, Mercedes-Maybach and Mercedes-EQ in the cars division, while Mobility supports vehicle sales. The company traces its origins to Gottlieb Daimler and Carl Benz and has its head office in Stuttgart, Germany.
